newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on CBOT soy, commission buying.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on CBOT soy, commission buying.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on commission house buying and gains in CBOT soybean futures, traders said.

"We ended up on the strength in soybeans, locals and commission houses bought. UGG and Cargill were sellers," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $2.40, Mar-July $2.50, Nov-Jan $3.50. January futures crush margin rose to -38.31 from Tuesday's close at -41.94. Volume was moderate.

January canola rose $0.50 a tonne to $409.50 and March climbed $1.20 to end at $412.20. January flax rose $0.80 to $367 on commercial sales and light hedges and U.S. and European export demand. Oats did not trade.
December feed peas rose US$2 to US$201 on commercial demand met by some hedges, traders said.
February western barley ended unchanged at $146 as CBOT corn rose and commercials bought, March also unchanged at $145.60. Mar-May spread at even money.
December wheat rose $4.50 to $176.50, March rose $4.20 to $176.50 with UGG buying as CBOT corn and wheat rose, traders said. Dec-Mar spread at $0.50, Mar-July $0.50.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
